items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And my sister and my mother, they played guitar, both guitar and piano. And my old man would get us out after dinner and make us all. We had Abby, Merritt, and Richie on trumpets, and my brother Henry on the trombone, and I played the upright alto.

ctx.x: Can you tell me some more about your home when you started? Your father and the rest of your family, what they played?
Well, there was Richard and my two late brothers Henry played trombone. My brother Rudy, he was the last one, Barrett. He was 70 years old. He played bass fiddle.
And Rudy was the oldest in the family.
